## Central question

What would make an investment attractive, and what could break the underwriting?

## Case selection

Select a company and state whether the case is a buyout or a venture investment. Use public information with dated sources.

## PE analysis

Outline entry valuation, financing, operating improvements, debt repayment, exit assumptions, and return sensitivities.

## VC analysis

Outline market size, customer adoption, competitive advantage, unit economics, dilution, and funding requirements.

## Investment committee discussion

Present the key decision, downside conditions, diligence questions, and reasons to pass.

## Status

Case selection and analysis are pending. No transaction or professional deal experience is implied.
